# signed-adc-sample

行为约定：
readSigned24(bytes, offset=0) decodes three little-endian bytes as a signed two's-complement 24-bit integer (-8388608..8388607). bytes is a Uint8Array or Buffer; offsets are relative to its visible view. Reject negative, noninteger, or out-of-view offsets with RangeError. Do not mutate bytes.

运行：`node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`。
只使用运行时标准库；保持公开接口及原有断言，不安装依赖，不联网。
